flagged.evidence: The Statement describes a finite POVM as a family of “positive operators,” but the current dependency def-qc-povm-and-outcome-law requires nonnegative effects, and def-non-negative-and-positive-operator reserves positive for operators with strictly positive quadratic form on every nonzero vector. For dim H > 1, a rank-one PVM effect has a nonzero kernel and is not positive in this library’s sense, contradicting the stated rank-one PVM attainment. The proof uses nonnegative effects; replacing “positive” with “nonnegative” resolves the conflict.
